question.title: Tell us about the milestone you finished
question.description: Well done for finishing your milestone! Use this form to tell Umuzi about it. You need two things: 1. The completion code Umuzi sent you. 2. Your milestone certificate (a PDF or a photo of it). Umuzi will check your answers and let you know. A red star * means you must answer.

elements.name: schema:email
elements.title: Your Umuzi email address
elements.description: The email address Umuzi gave you for the programme, not your personal email. We use it to find you. Check your spelling before you go on.
elements.requiredErrorText: Please write your Umuzi email address.

validators.text: Please check your email address. It should look like yourname@example.com

elements.name: schema:addressCountry
elements.title: Which country do you live in?
elements.description: Phase 2 is for people who live in South Africa. Tap South Africa to confirm.
elements.requiredErrorText: Please tap South Africa to confirm where you live.

elements.name: schema:temporalCoverage
elements.title: Which month's stipend are you making a claim for?
elements.description: Tap the box and choose the month this claim is for.
elements.requiredErrorText: Please choose the month you are claiming for.

elements.name: schema:name
elements.title: What is the name of the milestone you finished?
elements.description: Write the name as it shows on your milestone certificate. For example: Block 3 - Social Gig. Do not worry about dashes or capital letters.
elements.requiredErrorText: Please write the name of your milestone.

elements.name: ixo:evidenceType_completionCode
elements.title: Your completion code
elements.description: The code Umuzi sent you when you finished your milestone. Find that message, press and hold the code to copy it, then paste it here. Or type it carefully.

elements.name: ixo:evidenceType_certificate
elements.title: Your milestone certificate
elements.description: Add the certificate you got for this milestone. If it is a PDF, open it and save it to your phone first, then tap here and choose it. A clear photo or a screenshot of the certificate also works.

elements.name: dcterms:description_reflection
elements.title: What was it like to do this milestone? (optional)
elements.description: Tell us what went well and what was hard. You can write in any language. You can skip this. Your answer does not change whether your milestone is approved. It only helps Umuzi improve the programme.
